dedupe_keys.name: climate exposure dashboard for transport asian transport observatory prototype

description: The Climate Exposure Dashboard for Transport is a prototype web tool from the Asian Transport Observatory (ATO), built with IABG under the European Space Agency and Asian Development Bank Global Development Assistance programme, to assess and show the flood exposure of road networks in Asia and the Pacific. It overlays flood hazard information from earth observation with open road network data to show where major roads, especially motorways, cross flood-prone areas, using harmonised geospatial processing and consistent weighting when aggregating exposure indicators across countries. Coverage: selected Asia-Pacific countries in the prototype; the ATO plans more countries, assets (railways, ports, airports) and hazards. Format and access: an ArcGIS Experience web dashboard, launched in Bangkok in March 2026. Licence and cost: free to view; no licence stated. Caveats: a prototype showing exposure, not damage or disruption; the countries covered are not listed in the article. It supports hazard exposure screening, priority corridors for resilience investment and cross-country benchmarking. It relates to the global road and rail precipitation exposure study and GMTRA in the catalogue.
